newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH JAN-SEPT NEW PASSENGER CAR IMPORTS SURGE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH JAN-SEPT NEW PASSENGER CAR IMPORTS SURGE.

text.p: Imports of passenger cars to the Czech Republic surged 79 percent in the first nine months of 1996, year-on-year, to 51,440 units from 28,782, the Czech Car Importers Association (CIA) said on Wednesday.
It said that imports of new utility vehicles rose 35 percent in the period, year on year, to 9,809 units from 7,270 units. The figures exclude imports by individuals.
The CIA said thast the local car maker, Volkswagen AG unit Skoda Automobilova a.s., increased its passenger cars sales by 33 percent in the period to 60,708 units from 45,791.
The association said its passanger car market share increased to 45.85 percent from 38.48 a year ago.

The largest seller was Opel with 7,608 cars sold, followed by Volkswagen with 6,212. FIAT recorded the largest increase in sales, up 369 percent year on year to 5,242 units, taking fourth position after Ford.
